prompt: Studio product photograph of a precision optical glass and machined brass prism assembly resting on a textured dark basalt surface. Shot with a 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, extreme asymmetric off-centre framing. A single, solid beam of warm directional light hits the prism and sharply fractures into scattered, diffused rays due to one slightly misaligned glass plate. Softbox key light with visible falloff, long cast contact shadow, moody cinematic atmosphere, catalog clarity, generous editorial negative space.
